```{=html}
<section class="faq-split">
  <div class="faq-photo" role="img" aria-label="Gabrielle and Riley holding hands in front of the chapel at Colgate University."
       style="background-image:url('images/chapel.jpg')"></div>
  <div class="faq-banner">
    <h2 class="tpl-title faq-title">Questions</h2>
    <span class="diamond"></span>
    <p class="faq-lede">We’ve compiled a list of preliminary answers here and will update them as the day gets closer. If you have more questions, always feel free to reach out.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="faq-main">
    <div class="faq-inner">
      <h3 class="faq-group">The Day</h3>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>What time should I arrive?</summary>
        <p>The ceremony begins at 5:30 pm. Please plan to arrive by 5:00 so you have time to park
        and find a seat. The reception ends at 10:30 pm.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Is the wedding outside?</summary>
        <p>Partly. The ceremony is outside on the lawn overlooking Cayuta Lake. If it rains, we’ll
        move it under the clear-sided tent on the patio. Cocktail hour and dancing are on the
        covered patio, and dinner is inside the Inn’s banquet hall, which has air conditioning.
        You’re welcome to step inside at any point.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>What is the dress code?</summary>
        <p>We ask that guests wear formal attire. We suggest suits for men, and floor-length or
        tea-length dresses for women. If you have any questions, feel free to ask us. One practical
        note: the ceremony is on the lawn, so you may be more comfortable in block heels or flats.</p>
      </details>
      </div>
      <h3 class="faq-group">Guests &amp; RSVP</h3>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Can I bring a guest?</summary>
        <p>Unfortunately, due to capacity limits at our venue, your invitation will name everyone
        we have saved a seat for.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>When do we need to RSVP?</summary>
        <p>Invitations will go out in March 2027, and the RSVP deadline will be on them. You don’t
        need to do anything before then.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>I have a dietary restriction, can you accommodate?</summary>
        <p>Yes. Please let us know when you RSVP. Our caterer, Word of Mouth, regularly handles
        vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergy needs, and every dish at dinner will be
        labeled.</p>
      </details>
      </div>
      <h3 class="faq-group">Getting There</h3>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Is there parking at the venue?</summary>
        <p>Yes, there is plenty of free parking at the Inn if you choose to drive.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Will there be a shuttle?</summary>
        <p>Yes. We’re planning a shuttle from downtown Ithaca to the Inn before the ceremony and
        two trips back at the end of the night. See <a href="travel.html">Travel &amp; Stay</a>
        for details; we’ll post pickup times closer to the wedding.</p>
      </details>
        <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Where should I stay?</summary>
        <p>We aren’t holding a room block, so book whatever suits you. Our favorite hotels and
        inns are on the <a href="travel.html">Travel &amp; Stay</a> page. If you want to use the
        shuttle, stay in downtown Ithaca.</p>
      </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
